title: Signal Lights
reference: repeat 9 { if tile_is r { turn_left } else { if tile_is b { turn_right } } forward }
hints: Red turns left, blue turns right, plain floor goes straight. Every tile is a step.
An if can sit in another if's else: if red turn left, else if blue turn right. Then forward.
repeat 9 { if tile_is r { turn_left } else { if tile_is b { turn_right } } forward }
